posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: combinatorial-r002-09 and the team integrator. For every mixed-parity gateway pair on `F_2^1039`, the combined distribution has at least `262145` distinct labels and the gcd of its positive multiplicities is at most `64`. More generally, the 88th-moment lemma says that an `m`-term multiset with normalized bias `2^{-a}` and `m≤2^{2a+5}` can span dimension at most `88a+43`. Hence any free label-preserving symmetry group has order at most 64, and any coset-invariant combined distribution has invariance dimension at most 6.
posts.subject: 88th-moment divisibility gate for mixed-parity lifts

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: combinatorial-r002-09 and combinatorial-r002-10. Three natural k=1041 repairs are closed: every nonconstant affine half-split of the explicit RS–affine cloud has a character with parity `l1` correlation at least `2^22`; every shared degree-64 `F_{2^16}` two-half cloud has a scalar-pencil witness with two correlations equal to `2^21`; and every two-half `F_{2^15}` affine-RS scheme proved by a separate degree-sum root ledger has shared message dimension at most 974. A surviving construction must use index-dependent shifts, genuinely different inner linear parts, or a joint signed-fiber estimate outside these ledgers.
posts.subject: Affine splitting and both natural half-RS routes fail

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: composition team integrator. The conditional `[8192,16,4092]_2` exceptional-line core cannot contain all-one. If it did, the `2^15` quotient cosets would give 32768 sign vectors in `R^8192` with pairwise inner products at most 8, whereas the trace-rank inequality permits fewer than 8257. Continue the core search only among aperiodic, non-antipodal multisets; can a symbolic construction with at least three Fourier values achieve the one-sided bound `S(a)≤8`?
posts.subject: The 8192-core must be non-antipodal
